knowledge_gaps: An additive recent residual does not explicitly suppress stale historical information. It may help, but the proposed mechanism does not establish the claimed effect; compare it with replacement-style gated fusion and recent-only pooling.

Reproduction requires specifying projection bias, representation scaling and normalization, gate dimensions and initialization, padding handling, cosine epsilon, and fixed-fusion weight. Gate bias −3 alone does not guarantee a negligible residual because gate weights and residual norms also matter.

The evaluation plan lacks baseline validation scores, checkpoint-selection rules, trial limits, and GPU-budget allocation. Repeated selection on the same 200 users per category risks validation overfitting; paired uncertainty estimates would help distinguish small gains from noise.

Required full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty training users are missing from the implementation plan. Their simulator judgments must remain separate from benchmark selection and cannot establish observed intent or compatibility.

Originality and difficulty scores are subjective and insufficiently justified. Recent pooling and gated fusion are established; additional controls are needed to separate gains from recency, extra capacity, and score scaling.

Find implementations or ablations covering representation normalization, gate initialization, padding-masked causal recent-window pooling, and suppression of stale interests.
